subject: Spearhead demo — executive availability & concierge plan

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spearhead demo — executive availability & concierge plan

Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for the time today. Halcyon sounds like a wonderful fit for what the Redwood runtime is built for. Before we lock the demo, quick ask so we can tailor the run: will your CIO and VP of Cloud be able to join the first 20 minutes for the executive overview? If not, we’ll run the product deep-dive first and offer a dedicated 30-minute exec wrap.

Proposal: 45-minute session total — 15m exec overview (VP/CIO), 25m technical demo, 5m next steps. We can also schedule a 20-minute dry run for your execs the day before if helpful.

I attached a proposed run-of-show and the deck for context. If you share a target attendee list I’ll sketch names into the agenda and share updated calendar invites.

Available windows this week (PST):
- Tue 11/10 09:30–10:15
- Wed 11/11 13:00–13:45
- Thu 11/12 08:00–08:45 (earlier slot for APAC colleagues)

If none of those work, drop three slots that do and we’ll match.

Thanks — Priyom
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: halcyon-runofshow.pdf, redwood-demo-deck.pptx

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the clear proposal and the deck. Quick update: our CIO, Marcus Hale, is traveling on 11/10 and unavailable in the morning. VP Cloud (Tanya Rhee) can likely join for up to 20 minutes but prefers afternoon windows. The CDIO asked that we avoid anything before 11:30 PT due to an all-hands on Wed.

Can we do Wed 11/11 13:00 PT? That slot looks promising for the VP. If Marcus can't make it, we’d take the dedicated 30-minute exec wrap the day after. Also — we’d like a 15-minute dry run for our VP and her lead engineer on Tue 11/10 at 16:00 PT, if that’s possible.

Lydia
